MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The HDMI cable felt relevant because I have bought a display cable before, although I would need an HDMI connection specifically before choosing it.",
    "The wired earbuds with a microphone connect to my earlier headset purchase and could meet a similar audio need, but I am not currently looking for a replacement."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The smart speakers and streaming players do not address the computer connectivity or accessory needs behind my past purchases.",
    "My tablet mount purchase does not mean I need another tablet, and memory cards are not useful to me without a compatible device that needs storage."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "The recommendations seem to treat an interest in computer accessories as an interest in electronics generally.",
    "Several popular entertainment devices appeared even though my purchases give little reason to think I want voice assistants or TV streaming equipment."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My WiFi adapter, USB expansion card, and Ethernet adapter suggest practical needs for connecting devices and adding ports.",
    "The exact connection matters: a DVI cable does not establish a need for HDMI, and a related accessory only interests me when it solves a specific current problem.",
    "My purchases are spread over years, so an older headset or tablet accessory purchase is not enough to suggest I need a replacement now."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my interest in cables and wired audio but stretched my practical accessory purchases into a broad interest in entertainment devices."
}
